gloss: to pamper; to fawn over; to spoil with attention

definitions.gloss: to pamper, to fawn over, to make a fuss over
definitions.explanation: To lavish someone with attention, flattery, or favorable treatment. Often implies the attention is excessive or undeserved.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ちやほや⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ちやほや⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She is fawned over by everyone.

examples.japanese: ちやほや⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{我慢|がまん}できない→我慢する：25343_gamansuru⟧⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you grow up being pampered, you'll become an adult who can't endure hardship.

notes:
Mimetic word. Almost always used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: ちやほや⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to pamper/fawn over). Often appears in the passive: ちやほや⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be pampered).

Carries a negative or cautionary nuance. The speaker typically views the excessive attention as unhealthy or undeserved.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ちやほや⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to pamper, to fawn over
- ちやほや⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ — to be pampered, to be fawned over
- ちやほや⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧ — to grow up pampered
